mkp-data:query@1.name: query
mkp-data:query@1.about: Step through a query's stages (from, where, group, select, order) with each stage's rows computed.

inputs.name: where
inputs.about: conditions, all of which must hold

inputs.name: select
inputs.about: the columns kept when not grouping; empty keeps all

inputs.name: orderby
inputs.about: the column the result is sorted by

values.name: base

value.expr: map(range(0, len(table.rows) - 1), i => {id: "r" + i, cells: table.rows[i]})

comment: from: every row, with an id it keeps through the stages

values.name: holds
values.body: fold(where, true, (ok, c) => ok and compare(cell(cols, r.cells, c.col), c.op, c.value))
comment: where: the rows every condition holds for

values.name: grouping
comment: group: the distinct keys in order of first appearance, and each group's rows

value.expr: fold(kept, [], (ks, r) => if(indexof(ks, gkey(r)) >= 0, ks, ks + [gkey(r)]))

values.name: outcols

value.expr: if(grouping, if(groupby == "", [], [groupby]) + map(aggs, a => agglabel(a)), if(len(select) == 0, cols, select))

comment: select: the output columns and rows

if(numeric, sort(outrows, r => number(okey(r))), sort(outrows, r => okey(r)))

*One aggregate over all rows: the total of a column.*

```sql
FROM orders
GROUP (all rows as one group)
SELECT sum(qty) AS total
```

**1. FROM orders** (3 rows)

| item | qty |
| --- | --- |
| pen | 3 |
| ink | 2 |
| pad | 5 |

**2. GROUP (all rows as one group)** (1 group)

| item | qty |
| --- | --- |
| **all rows · 3 rows** |  |
| pen | 3 |
| ink | 2 |
| pad | 5 |

**3. SELECT sum(qty) AS total** (one row per group)

| total |
| --- |
| 10 |
